summary.zh: 用字体、色彩、间距建立统一视觉
summary.en: Typography, color, spacing, and iconography fundamentals.

description.zh: 从字体排布、色彩理论、间距体系和图标风格入手，建立一套前后一致的视觉规则。适合制定设计规范、整理设计令牌，或改善界面的层级与一致性。
description.en: Establishes consistent visual rules from typography, color theory, spacing systems, and iconography. Useful for style guides, design tokens, or fixing hierarchy and consistency in an existing interface.
